personName.title: Person using this computer
personName.description: Shown in logs, e.g. 'Grandma Jean' or 'Front desk PC'.

forceProtectionsOn.title: Keep all protections on
forceProtectionsOn.description: Website allowlist, always-block list, file types and scam words cannot be switched off.

forwardUrl.title: Log collector URL
forwardUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives events (Splunk HEC, Logstash/Fluent Bit HTTP input, Azure Logic App, n8n, etc.).

forwardFormat.title: Log format
forwardFormat.description: json (array), ndjson, or splunk (HEC event format).

subscriptions.title: Extra online lists
subscriptions.description: Lists added for every computer. They cannot be removed by the user.
